reading_issues: Full-page Propagation Labs PNG, mirrored layout, no grain table and no temperature profile. Heights from 10 cm gridlines (11.2 px/cm; HS 223 at y=355.5, blue PIT 103 line at y=1699.5): pit bottom at 103 cm above ground, so the lower 103 cm of snowpack is not dug. Profile name printed as 'My Fairview TL/BTL' (sic; filename says Mt Faiview BTL E aspect). Header aspect (E) and elevation (2170 m) are present and agree with the filename band 'BTL E aspect'; the 'BTL' band is from the filename only and the profile name also says TL/BTL, so treeline vs below-treeline is ambiguous. Lowest layer is tapered (layer mean). Failure-layer grain/size and the name 'Jan 24th' come only from the CT23SP label. CTN label is drawn at the top with no height; notes say 'NR on 1/2 CT's'. Air temp and blowing snow blank.
